silverado.name: Used 2024 Chevrolet Silverado EV Work Truck

limits: Purchase bands and targets are editorial search budgets inferred from a small set of specific observed results and asks, not statistical market valuations or executable offers. Source details are in docs/sample-fleets.md.

Maintenance ranges are unquoted annual funding allowances for low-mileage recreational use of already-sorted cars, including servicing/wear/minor repairs. They exclude storage, insurance, fuel/electricity, depreciation, major failures and initial catch-up work; no statistical confidence implied.

Setup arithmetic uses acquisition tax, formation/setup and initial management fee from finance/assumptions.json. Fee, transport and initial work allowances are additional estimates; replace them with listing-specific fees/quotes. No tax credits, incentives or resale gains assumed.

Repair cash is held in the bank and is not counted as spending. Cash shown after setup excludes future operating spend; preserve an operating buffer separately. Neither repair earmark estimates a maximum potential loss.

Model figures retain the initial $10k management setup fee for comparability; member-led coordination could change that if the founder decides. These cases do not automatically change insurance or other recurring base inputs.
